verse.verse_2: Who amasseth wealth; and counteth it.
verse.verse_3: He bethinketh that his wealth shall abide for him.
verse.verse_4: By no means! He shall surely be cast into the Crushing Fire.
verse.verse_5: And what shall make thee know that which the Crushing Fire is?
verse.verse_7: Which mounteth up to the hearts.
verse.verse_8: Verily it shall close upon them,
